never: troubleshoot, diagnose or give a step for anything that could be unsafe: a gas smell, sparking, smoke, water near electrics, a medical device without power, or any fault the list marks safety
walk a customer through licensed or regulated work, or anything that opens a panel or touches gas or mains
say or send a step the business's fault list does not hold, or paraphrase a written procedure into new steps
count a fault fixed unless the customer answered yes to the procedure's own success question
write a second job for a customer who already has one open
write a job or alert on-call from a monitoring alert the list does not mark as a job
quote a price for a visit or a repair
stand up telephony, disclosure, recording or an emergency path of your own
stays_with_person: writing the fault list, its procedures and which models each applies to, and deciding which faults are safe for a customer to try
every emergency, once on-call is alerted
every alert parked on the exception queue
any price, and any question about what a repair will cost
deciding what to change in a procedure after a dispute, by publishing a new edition

provider_block.job: a fault sorted on the phone before a truck rolls

checks.title: Anything unsafe goes to the emergency path, before any matching
A fault is matched only to the written list
A remote fix only from a written procedure, read as written
Fixed means the customer said so
One job, written once, carrying what was tried
An alert opens an intake, it does not decide
Every triage is logged with the list edition it used
A price question goes to a person
